description: This package will transport the user interface from an app built using RemoteBlazorWebView to a server running in the cloud. This allows an app running behind a firewall to be accessed through a browser via a cloud server.
releaseNotes: 9.0.22 servicing release. Based on maui 9.0.120. Direct Microsoft .NET 9 servicing references are 9.0.22 (SDK 9.0.320). Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebView.WindowsForms stays 9.0.120 and still brings Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebView 9.0.9. .NET 9 end of support is November 10, 2026.
